_description: Persistent CC mapping registry for notation symbol → MIDI CC translation. Used by AI analysis (Option A), \set context properties (Option E), and future automated tools.

95.notes: Pizzicato velocity patch. Stays active until another articulation mode is set.

71.notes: Pizzicato open strings velocity patch. One-shot: composer must explicitly revert to current mode after the note.

97.revert_pattern: \midiBartokPizz → note → revert to base mode (e.g. \midiPizz). Consecutive Bartók pizz notes: no revert needed between them.
97.notes: Bartók (snap) pizzicato patch. Always explicitly notated. One-shot: revert to current base mode after the note, unless the next note is also Bartók pizz.

70.notes: Molto vibrato in pizzicato context. One-shot: revert to pizz base mode after the note.

2.notes: Molto vibrato in arco context. One-shot: revert to arco base mode after the note.

6.notes: Open string in arco context. One-shot: revert to arco base mode after the note.

sfz.notes: Sforzando — maximum velocity for the marked note/chord only. Composer must \midiVelReset after the note.

midiGliss.purpose: Pitch bend glissando. +1 = up 1 semitone, -1 = down 1 semitone, 0.5 = quarter tone up. modify_midi.js inserts 20-step linear ramp across note duration, resets to center before next Note On. Synth pitch bend range: ±1 semitone.

state_rules.persistent: CC0 value stays active until a different articulation mode is set (e.g., pizz stays until arco). Composer sets once, applies to all following notes.
state_rules.one-shot: Value applies only to the marked note. Composer must explicitly revert after the note (Option A: manual revert).
state_rules.mode_persistence: The base mode (pizz/arco) persists until the composer explicitly changes it. Do NOT infer mode changes from expression markings (e.g., 'm.v.' does not imply arco). Only explicit 'arco' or 'pizz.' text resets the base mode.
